property_summary: After any successful fallback call at timestamp t, a further fallback call must fail at every timestamp t2 <= t+1 (since pastBlockTime is set to t+1); the mutant stores t instead, so a call at exactly t+1 wrongly succeeds.
change_summary: Change the assignment to `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` so the stored value is the current timestamp rather than timestamp+1.
